subject: general
question: Which of the following directors was awarded an honorary Palme d'Or during the closing ceremony of the 74th Cannes Film Festival, for his extraordinary filmmaking career?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Marco Bellochio.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• During the Closing Ceremony of the** 74th Cannes Film Festival **held on the evening of July 17, 2021,** Italian director Marco Bellochio **received an **Honorary Palme d'Or for his extraordinary filmmaking career.**
 
• Marco Bellocchio is one of the **most consistent and most adventurous of today's Italian directors**-an achievement all the more remarkable given that he made his feature **debut almost fifty years ago.**
 
• **Bellocchio's films include:**
 
 
• **China is Near (1967).** 
 
• Nel Nome del Padre (In the name of the Father)(1972).
 
• **Victory March (1976), A Leap in the Dark (1980).**
 
• **Henry IV (1984).** 
 
• Devil in the Flesh (1986).
 
• My Mother's Smile (2002).
 
 
 
• **He was awarded the Golden Lion for Lifetime Achievement at the 68th Venice International Film Festival in September 2011.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **Cannes Film Festival:**

 
 
• It is an annual film festival started in 1946 and held in Cannes, France, which previews new films of all genres, including documentaries, from all around the world.
 
• The** 75th annual Cannes Film Festival **is a film festival that took place from 17 to 28 May 2022.
 
• **Ruben Ostlund's 'Triangle of Sadness' Wins Palme d'Or at 2022 Cannes Film Festival.**
